_comment: The number of national government sub-counties is contested and moving.
This file records what each source says, so the discrepancy is documented
rather than silently resolved in favour of whichever was loaded first.

shipped.basis: knbs-subcounty-wards.csv, the KNBS/DHIS2 sub-county listing mapped to wards
shipped.note: Independently matches the AfroCave county/sub-county table, which also totals 301.

otherSources.source: AfroCave, List of Counties and Sub-Counties in Kenya
otherSources.note: Its per-county lists are largely the constituencies: Baringo is listed as Baringo Central, Baringo North, Baringo South, Eldama Ravine, Mogotio, Tiaty, which are that county's six constituencies rather than its administrative sub-counties.

otherSources.source: 314 plus the 27 sub-counties gazetted by the Interior Ministry
otherSources.note: Part of 578 new administrative units: 27 sub-counties, 59 divisions, 170 locations and 322 sub-locations, across 31 counties. Press lists of the 27 are unreliable — several print 31 names under a headline count of 27 — so no list is committed here.

gazettements.note: Not yet reflected in any dataset shipped here. Applying it needs the gazette notice itself, not press summaries.
